jobText:
Frontend Developer (React)
Nordlicht Software · Remote within the EU · Full-time

Nordlicht Software makes scheduling tools for physiotherapy clinics in Germany, Austria and the Netherlands.

What you'll do
- Build new screens in our React and TypeScript web app.
- Work closely with our designer and turn Figma files into accessible components.
- Improve test coverage and performance.

Requirements
- 1+ year of professional experience building React applications.
- Good TypeScript.
- Responsive, accessible HTML and CSS.
- Experience working with REST APIs.
- GraphQL with Apollo Client.
- End-to-end testing with Playwright or Cypress.

Nice to have
- You have worked from Figma designs.
- Next.js.

Location
This is a remote role within the European Union. You must live in an EU member state and have the right to work there. We cannot sponsor visas or hire contractors outside the EU.

Salary: 42,000–52,000 EUR.
